SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL TENDER. Written for tests/test_uk.py only.

INVITATION TO TENDER - LV AND CONTAINMENT SUBCONTRACT

1.1  TENDER RETURN
Tenders shall be returned via the portal no later than 12:00 noon on Friday 13 November 2026.
A mid-tender site visit is mandatory and will take place at 10:00 on 3 November 2026.
Performance bond: a performance bond of 10% of the Subcontract Sum is required.
Tender queries shall be submitted no later than 6 November 2026. Late queries will not be answered.
Tenders shall remain open for acceptance for 90 days from the tender return date.

1.2  CONTRACT
The form of contract shall be the JCT Design and Build Sub-Contract 2016 with the Schedule of Amendments at Appendix 2.
Liquidated and ascertained damages shall be £5,000 per week or part thereof.
A parent company guarantee will be required from the successful tenderer.
Collateral warranties shall be provided to the funder and tenant.
Retention shall be 3% reducing to 1.5% at Practical Completion.
The date for Practical Completion is 26 weeks from the date of possession.
Public liability insurance of £10,000,000 for any one occurrence is required.
The Sub-Contractor is responsible for the detailed design of the containment as a Contractor's Designed Portion.
The Sub-Contractor shall hold CHAS, Constructionline Gold and NICEIC accreditation.
Variant tenders will not be accepted. Qualified tenders may be rejected.
Tender addenda issued during the tender period shall be acknowledged on the Form of Tender.
Tenderers shall complete and return the Form of Tender and the Pricing Schedule.
SECTION Y61 LV CABLES AND WIRING

110  SCOPE
All installations shall comply with BS 7671.
Cable containment shall be Unistrut or approved equivalent.
Testing and commissioning shall be deemed included in the Contract Sum.
Firestopping to all penetrations shall be provided at no additional cost to the Employer.
The Sub-Contractor shall allow for all out of hours working in the live data hall.

Submit installation drawings for all cable ladder routes no later than 4 weeks prior to installation.
Additional supports shall be installed as directed by the Contract Administrator.
Make good all finishes to match existing.
